_schema._about: Content for /apply — the creator application form. Linked from /join and from the recruitment poster (assets/brand/creator-poster.png). British English. The form posts to the endpoint in form.endpoint; when that is empty it falls back to composing an email to form.fallback_to, so the page works with no backend. Do not add a hosted form service without adding it to the privacy policy's processor table.
_schema.form: {endpoint, fallback_to, legend_*, *_label / *_help / *_placeholder, socials[{key, label, base}], audience_options[], content_options[], niche_options[], kit_options[], times_options[], found_options[], submit, note, copy, status_*}. socials[].base is the profile URL an @handle is turned into in the emailed application (the handle is appended).

meta.title: Apply to create for hypjam: paid UGC briefs, no follower minimum
meta.description: Apply to hypjam's creator roster in about four minutes: your socials, what you make and one example of your work. Paid briefs for UK and remote creators, no follower minimum.

hero.intro: It takes about four minutes. Tell us where to find you, what you make and one thing you are proud of. There is no follower minimum and no showreel to build, and a person reads every application.

form.email_help: We reply here. Nothing else goes to this address.
form.location_help: Some briefs need creators in a particular place.
form.discord_help: Your username, not your display name. Leave it blank if you do not use Discord.
form.socials_help: Add every account you have. An @handle or a link both work. Skip any you do not use; we need at least one.
form.other_help: One per line: Lemon8, a link-in-bio page, a UGC marketplace profile, anything else.
form.audience_label: Your biggest following on any one platform
form.audience_help: There is no minimum. This only helps us match briefs.
form.experience_label: Have you made UGC for a brand before?
form.experience_help: Either answer is fine. We cast on fit, not on a track record.
form.profiles_label: Links to UGC you have made for brands
form.profiles_help: One per line: posts, a portfolio, a Drive folder, whatever shows the work.
form.example_label: Link to one example of your work
form.example_help: Everyone answers this, experienced or not. A post you filmed, a video you edited, or something you made to show what you can do. Paste a public link from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Drive or Dropbox.
form.content_label: What kind of videos do you make?
form.niche_label: Which niches do you know best?
form.kit_help: Pick any that apply. A phone is all most briefs need.
kit_options: A phone from the last few years
form.rate_label: Your usual rate for one video
form.rate_help: A rough figure is fine. We always agree the rate with you before you film.
form.found_help: It helps us know where to keep looking.
found_options: An AI agent or web scraper
form.extra_help: Languages you can film in, products you will not promote, places you can shoot.
form.age_help: We can only work with adult creators.
form.note: Applying does not guarantee work; it puts you on the list we cast from. What you send is covered by our
form.status_mail: Your email app should open with everything filled in. Send it and you are done. If nothing opens, copy your answers and email them to
form.status_copied: Copied. Paste them into an email to
form.status_fix: Some answers need a look. See the notes above.

steps: A person reads it. Not a filter, not a score.
If you fit a brief we are casting, we email you with the brief, the rate and the usage before you agree to anything.
If you do not hear back straight away it means nothing fits yet. We keep applications for up to two years and come back to them.
